# Hand-authored IMS-style unit fixture

**These are invented numerical values**, created for MotorPulse AI parser tests.
They are **not IMS recordings, extracted waveforms, sensor measurements,
or licensed source data**, and the file dates are fake test identifiers.

- Two timestamp-like ASCII filenames (not verified real IMS timestamps)
- Four samples per file, four columns, whitespace separators
- Fake declared sample rate **8 Hz** (duration 0.5 s per file)
- Example bearing map created by the test author only

No claim about IMS actual sample rates, bearing mapping, waveform amplitude
units, timezone, or failure labels can be drawn from these files.
